_note: Written with AI assistance (Claude Code). Generated by pipeline/diagnostics/orbit_model.py; regenerate it, never hand-edit. A statistical model of NASA's published rates, not a NASA result and not a physics simulation.
scope: Microgravity (0 g) on the space station, opposed forced flow, PMMA rods only. Valid only inside the measured ranges listed for each rod diameter. It is not a model of any other gravity level, material, flow direction or of zero flow.

training.source: Link et al. 2018, Sci Rep 8:120, Supplement Table S1, p. 1
training.rate_conversion: rate_mm_s = printed Vf x 10^3 value x 0.01, both halves (docs/DATA_CONTRACTS.md section 6)

selection_rule: Fixed before any score was computed: publish the model with the lowest leave-one-sample-out median absolute % error. If other models are within 1 percentage point of the best, publish the simplest of them (order: mean, log-linear, Gaussian process, random forest). All four are reported.

cv.scheme: leave-one-sample-out: 19 folds, all rows of one sample held out together
cv.metric_notes: ape = absolute % error on held-out rows; coverage95 = share of held-out rows inside the model's 95% predictive interval; median_ape_ci95_pct = cluster bootstrap over samples (5000 resamples, seed 0), models not refitted

models.name: Baseline 1: log-linear fit, ln(rate) = a + b ln(flow) + c O2 + d ln(diameter)
Gaussian process (standardized inputs, anisotropic RBF + white noise)
Random forest (500 trees, min leaf 2)
models.interval_note: The forest has no interval of its own. Its band is prediction times or divided by exp(q), q = 95th percentile of the held-out |ln error|. In this coverage check each row's q leaves out that row's own sample.

cv.why: forest has the lowest held-out median absolute % error (13.93%) and no other model is within 1 percentage point of it.

cv_sensitivity_one_rod_for_ab_samples.note: Samples with an a/b suffix treated as one rod (our assumption). Reported only; not used to choose.

colour_check.rule: Fixed before any score was computed: colour (clear = sample ID starts with C, Supplement Table S1 caption, p. 1) is added to the published model only if it lowers that model's leave-one-sample-out median absolute % error by more than 1 percentage point.
colour_check.source: Link et al. 2018, Sci Rep 8:120, Supplement Table S1 caption, p. 1

model.name: Random forest (500 trees, min leaf 2)
model.target: ln(rate_mm_s); the reported rate is exp(predicted mean) = the predictive median
model.interval: the forest has no interval of its own: lo95 = rate / band_factor, hi95 = rate x band_factor, band_factor = exp(q), q = 95th percentile of the held-out |ln error| over all rows. The band has the same relative width everywhere

diagnostics.note: Fits on all rows, kept to explain the scores. Not used to choose.

effects.note: Intervals marked cluster_bootstrap resample whole samples (2000 resamples, seed 0). ci95_ols ignores that rows of one sample are correlated.
effects.chosen_model_contrasts_note: rate at 'to' divided by rate at 'from'; the model has no interval of its own: the interval is a cluster bootstrap over samples (200 refits, seed 0), percentile method. Middle = the median of that diameter's measured values.

grid_notes.axes: arrays are indexed [o2][flow]; flow is log-spaced, O2 is evenly spaced
grid_notes.bounds: lo95/hi95 = 95% predictive interval for one new measured step
grid_notes.limits: each grid covers only that rod diameter's measured flow range and measured O2 range. A corner of the box can still be far from any measured row: check nearest_row_distance.
grid_notes.nearest_row_distance: distance to the nearest measured row of the same diameter, in standard deviations of the training rows: sqrt((d ln flow / sd)^2 + (d O2 / sd)^2), sd ln flow = 0.5260, sd O2 = 1.3966 %
grid_notes.pmma: black and clear rods pooled (colour is not a model input)

outside_comparison.note: Our own measured steps against the model. Reported only: nothing is tuned to it. Our steps come from tests that are also rows of Table S1, so 'all_rows' is not independent of NASA's rate for the same step. 'sample_held_out' refits the model without that test's Table S1 rows.
